Call for expression of interest - International consultants Disability and Inclusion ACCESSIBILITY - 
August 2021 
5 
 
HI undertakes to give priority to consultants who have signed this framework contract with HI, for 
any consultancy falling within the scope of this call for expression of interest. 
However, neither the consultant nor HI commit to exclusivity or to an obligation of collaboration 
during these 3 years. 
III. Desired expertise 
 
In particular in the following fields of intervention: 
 
 Accessibility of buildings, infrastructures and urban spaces 
 Accessibility in emergency contexts (shelter, WASH, refugee camps, etc.) 
 Digital accessibility, websites, mobile applications, files and ICT in general 
 Accessibility of mobility solutions and means of transport 
 Accessibility of early warning systems (in the field of Disaster Risk Reduction) 
 
And/or on cross-cutting skills such as : 
□ Managing an Accessibility project cycle (from project writing to final evaluation) 
□ Training 
□ Supporting an organization or service to be more inclusive of people with disabilities 
□ Support for individual or collective empowerment/self-determination 
□ Writing knowledge management documents (capitalization, studies, best practices, briefs...) 
 
IV. Applications 
1. Apply for a job 
Interested consultants in joining the pool have to : 
□ Fill out the online questionnaire 
□ Send by e-mail to ita@hi.org the documents requested in the questionnaire, 
indicating "accessibility consultant" in the subject line: 
o CV 
o Document proving legal registration of activity (or current application) 
o Proof of insurance  
o GNI 
The CV will highlight trainings, skills and experience relevant to the types of 
assignment, areas of expertise and geographical areas covered by this call for 
expressions of interest.
